note.title: Healthy living and lifestyle
note.specFocus: Healthy and unhealthy eating, exercise, sleep, stress, smoking and alcohol, physical and mental health, illness, medical appointments, and healthier choices.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Healthy living and lifestyle

Key vocabulary
- la dieta equilibrada; la comida basura; las verduras; evitar; estar en forma; hacer ejercicio; dormir; el estrés; fumar; el tabaco; me duele; tener fiebre; la receta; sanar; saludable; adelgazar; la obesidad

Key grammar
- Use me duele(n) + body part, deber/tener que/hay que for advice, the imperfect for old habits, and the preterite for a completed illness or incident. Use the conditional for recommended changes.

Exam tips
- Check whether a time phrase describes a routine or a finished event. If you use a modal recommendation, keep the next verb in the infinitive.

questions.examTip: Read each sentence for the person, verb tense and any negative or time marker before answering in English.
questions.modelAnswer:
1. I usually have yoghurt with fruit for breakfast and drink water during the day.
2. I play basketball three times a week to keep fit.
3. I used to eat too many sweets, but now I avoid sugar.
questions.question:
Listening-style written practice (read the transcript; there is no audio):

Lucía dice: «Suelo desayunar yogur con fruta y bebo agua durante el día. Juego al baloncesto tres veces a la semana para estar en forma. Antes comía demasiados dulces, pero ahora evito el azúcar.»

Answer in English.
1. What does Lucía say about the first topic?
2. What extra detail is given in the second statement?
3. What is the main idea of the final statement?
